rubrics.justification: Generally consistent with a 2BB blastocyst and notes loose ICM/TE, but it over-interprets image details such as vacuoles, debris, and a polar body/extruded fragment that are not clearly discernible from this single image.
Thoroughly integrates maternal age, prior miscarriage, tubal factor, endometrium, ovarian response, sperm parameters, and lifestyle factors with embryo quality and prognosis.
Reasoning is structured and mostly logical, with a clear path from morphology and patient factors to prognosis, though some quantitative adjustments and assumptions are somewhat speculative.

Mostly aligned on embryo grading and general prognosis, but includes recommendations with weaker guideline support or case-specific justification such as aspirin, ERA/EMMA-ALICE after a single failure, exercise restriction, and strong endorsement of PGT-A.
Provides clear practical next steps for transfer management and future cycles, though some suggestions are more aggressive than standard practice and not all are equally evidence-based.
